name: mirage
text: I checked GitHub's live status. The Kalshi lane on the GitHub engine is set to OFF, so it isn't scanning or listing Kalshi bets. Its own status line reads: off (the phone's Kalshi tab > Setup > GitHub engine). The Kalshi toggles you've had on only cover Kalshi as a source of odds that prices Novig bets. That part works: Kalshi was read in every scan I checked. It does not list Kalshi bets. To see them, open the Kalshi tab > Setup > GitHub engine and set the mode to Paper (lists and tracks without real money) or Live. Only you can set that switch: it's a phone-only switch by your own rule (Kalshi can trade real money), so I haven't changed it. If you set it to Paper and no Kalshi bets show within a few minutes, tell me and I'll look into why.
